# Bylda

> Bylda is behavioral sales intelligence software. It turns recorded sales calls and CRM activity into behaviors, patterns and outcomes, gives each rep one change to make, and measures whether the behavior changed. It is for sales managers, revenue leaders, enablement teams and sales reps. It is not a CRM, not a call recorder, and not a dashboard.

Full page text for retrieval: https://usebylda.com/llms-full.txt

## In one paragraph

Sales software has measured activity for thirty years: calls made, meetings booked, stages advanced. Bylda measures the behavior between the activity and the outcome. Every insight shows its sample size and confidence, says "associated with" unless the data supports cause, and points to the moment in the call that is its evidence. Coaching is one focus at a time, never a course or a quiz, and reps never see peer leaderboards.

## How the product works

The loop is Events, Behaviors, Patterns, Outcomes, then Change and Measure.

- **Events** — what happened: calls, talk turns, objections, stage moves.
- **Behaviors** — how people acted: discounting, discovery depth, objection handling, interruptions, talk and listen.
- **Patterns** — what repeats, for whom, and when.
- **Outcomes** — what it produced: next steps, stage moves, wins and losses.
- **Change** — one focus per rep, with the reason and the words to try, delivered in a daily brief.
- **Measure** — whether the behavior changed, before and after, with the confidence stated.

The product pages describe the same loop with a second vocabulary: Trace (one timestamped piece of evidence), Signal (a trace that matters in context), Echo (a signal that repeats across calls, reps or outcomes), Directive (the one change worth making) and Outcome (the test of the directive). The Phantom Audit is the continuous audit of every conversation; the Behavior Graph is the accumulated link between behavior and outcome inside one company.

Inputs are the team's CRM, dialer and call recorder, or a manual upload.

## What ships now and what does not

The first release covers call review, behavior analysis, rep behavior profiles, daily briefs for reps and managers, the coach queue, assigned coaching and behavior change results. Weekly reports, team trends, call comparison and Slack or Teams delivery are on the roadmap. The behavioral outcome graph, buyer models and simulations are concepts, not product. See https://usebylda.com/vision for the honest account.

Bylda does not claim: certainty about individual deal outcomes, proof of causation from observed association, emotion or sentiment scoring, guaranteed revenue uplift, or autonomous selling.

## Who it is for

- **Sales managers and heads of sales** — "What should I coach today, and did it work?" A manager with eight reps has about 300 conversations a week and time for five.
- **Sales reps and AEs** — "What do I change on my next call?" A 60-second brief with one focus.

## How it differs

- **Versus a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot):** a CRM records what someone typed. Bylda measures conduct inside the conversations. The CRM stays the system of record.
- **Versus conversation intelligence (for example Gong):** conversation intelligence reports on one call at a time. Bylda looks for behaviors repeating across calls, reps and outcomes, returns one change per rep and measures whether it happened.
- **Versus revenue and forecasting platforms (for example Clari):** those aggregate what is already in the CRM. Bylda works upstream, in the conversations that produced the records.

## Pricing

Phantom is $89 per rep per month and Team is $129 per rep per month. Enterprise is custom. Details and what each plan includes: https://usebylda.com/pricing. Access is opening in waves; request access at https://usebylda.com/waitlist.

## Security and data handling

Customer conversations are never used to train shared or third-party models. For the current security posture, subprocessors and data residency, read https://usebylda.com/security rather than relying on this summary.
